goal: Rental operator can convert eligible channel orders and review incomplete records.
non_goals: Do not add a controller, scheduler, admin UI, mapping correction flow, daily allocation, device schedule, device assignment, refund handling, raw payload access, third-party API call, or third-party write.
Do not save credentials, private customer fields, raw payloads, or fabricated rental periods.
expected_evidence: Focused seller-remark parser and conversion transaction tests
Maven module test output and no-write-path scan
unsafe_assumptions: The current normalized channel order has at most one product/SKU pair; a future line-item normalization slice will extend the conversion service.
stop_condition: Stop if the task requires a third-party write, an undocumented source field, a controller/scheduler, device allocation, a destructive migration, or files outside the allowed scope.
